newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Ringgit not to affect investment flows - minister.
newsitem.headline: Ringgit not to affect investment flows - minister.

text.p: The Malaysian ringgit's rise against the dollar since the beginning of the year will not affect foreign investment flows into the country, Minister for International Trade and Industry Rafidah Aziz said on Thursday.
"We don't see that happening," she said when asked by an industry representative if ringgit's strength willl slow down foreign direct investment in Malaysia's manufacturing sector.
"People have come in for a whole range of reasons. The ringgit has not really been a factor for them," she said at the ministry's annual briefing to industry and diplomats.
The ringgit has risen by nearly two percent against the U.S. dollar since the start of 1997.
